tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, Reuse (extract before the second use), shared files and Tool facts; Decisions 3-4, 7-9 and 13; Acceptance evidence 3 (Lock and shared test seams), Security impact and Rollout order. FIRST extract the lock and atomicWrite/link/mode checks from cli/write-install.ts into cli/lock.ts and cli/safe-write.ts, with their tests, and migrate init. Preserve ownership-by-content release and recorded signals. Extend lock with Decision 3's five-line pid/nonce/host/started/command content, ps -o lstart= and same-host stale judgement behind injected process.kill/ps/hostname/files seams. Break only gone/reused pids under wx 0600 .pulse-init.lock.break, byte-equal reread, unlink/own wx/directory fsync; refuse unknown, foreign, legacy, live and changing locks and always release an owned break file. Acquire before guard/journal/upgrade.json/recovery reads. Rewrite docs/cli.md's stale-lock guidance for init, token rotate and upgrade, including automatic conditions, shared-host manual checks and both lock files. Add matching docs assertions now; macos-15 ps output evidence belongs to T6. safe-write.ts owns the single validated-state reader/durable writer, safe writes and archive finalization with file and directory fsync. One injected file seam exposes open/read/write/file-fsync/rename/directory-fsync/unlink and records token-file lstat/read events. It must preserve observable on-disk renames when a later fsync throws, offer ONE validated read-back after a failed state write without retry, and simulate errors or hard kills without cleanup. Consumer reconciliation/action tables stay in T4/T5. Extend cli/docker.ts's sole spawn for input/stdinFd/stdoutFd, default ignored stdin, fd bytes and binary-named ENOENT (Docker remains exit 3, gh becomes exit 1). Return checkConfig's already-parsed effective Compose model in Project, with own()/isObj readers; preserve override/--no-interpolate and one resolution call. Export and reuse PULSE_IMAGE/assertPin from cli/services.ts with runtime-assembled shape fixtures. Extend parsePs for full ID and readyz/waitReady for container targeting; no duplicate guard, poller, pin pattern or spawn. cli/api-call.ts owns constant API_SCRIPT (stdin JSON, fixed localhost URL, 10 s fetch, 11 s unref'd exit 70, redirect:error, 1 MiB cap) and the timingSafeEqual file-comparison script (stdin expected secret, same/different only, 10 s bound). The client ending is never a server barrier: implement no settle process scan or SETTLE_SCRIPT. Extend cli/test/fake-docker.ts as the sole fake spawn with input/fds/signals/full ids/states/labels and named stop-at-step hooks. Prepare API stop/start/inspect and helpers surviving client death for T4/T5; those tasks own the server-write and helper-phase fault matrices. Each shared module states its ownership and tests its variants.

Keep this one recovery algorithm and its fault matrices together. Preflight ALL candidates, files and exactly-one ready consumer for every item before any POST; record oldContainerId. Journal requested/replacing/staged/saved/refreshing/refreshed/handoff/switched/revoking/done with validated ids, activeTokenId/revokeTokenId/replacementName, old/new container ids and inFlight. Stage rotate/create secrets through wx 0600 temp, file fsync, staging rename and directory fsync; durable staged(activeTokenId,inFlight:null) BEFORE install rename/directory fsync, then saved. On EVERY resume and EVERY stage/save error discard the in-memory secret and immediately reconcile from the journal ON DISK in the same process, before classifying lost answers. Reconcile validates journal, deletes recognized temps/fsyncs secrets, matches all staging names/files/states/ownership without API calls, confirms replacing rows, then acts in order. Failure of reconcile fsync/install/state write exits 1 with disk files/journal kept, no retry of another row. No owned host bearer is read before reconcile completes. The sole host-bearer exception is probe's independent admin-token: staging checks -> lstat/link/mode -> read/content validation -> self capability 200/admin -> GET replacement, in ONE event log shared by file seam and fake API. Admin confirms with staged secret. Invalid staging refuses before the independent admin read. Distinguish staged-with-file from staged-without-file; never return to replacing after staged or enter replacing while a staging file exists. Revoke guard before EVERY revoke refuses calling id and activeTokenId. Use the SAME Rotate outcome table first-run/resume: ok parsed 200; rejected documented complete JSON refusal; ambiguous transport/5xx/malformed/other; none resume. Before every rotate/create POST durably mark inFlight in requested/replacing respectively. Unanswered write recovery is the Decision 8 Barrier, NOT a client-process scan: exactly one API container, compose stop --timeout 10 api, inspect Running=false/Pid=0, start api/waitReady, durable inFlight:null, print restart duration. Run before any readback, sweep or next POST while disk marker is set; matching staging confirmation is the sole exception because that answer was parsed. A barrier failure keeps marker, exits 1 with api-may-be-stopped/rerun-or-pulse-up hint, sends no further API calls, and reruns the barrier. Normal parsed rotation restarts no api. Rejected answers need no first-run barrier; clear marker in the next state/drop. Readback same/changed/gone/unknown determines retry/drop/replacement/hold exactly as Decision 8; at most 2 rotate POSTs per item/run. Replacing entry only for changed rotatedAt OR parsed ok rotate whose stage-error reconcile found no staging file. Persist replacementName/revokeTokenId before create. Replacing begins with marker-triggered barrier, then exact-name orphan sweep only after reconcile found no held replacement. Unconfirmed revoke prevents create. Create parsed 201 stages; rejected clears marker/exits 1 without another create; ambiguous or lost staging returns to barrier+sweep before another create. At most 2 creates per item/run; before limit exit finish the last barrier/sweep, leave replacing/inFlight:null and no unheld replacement. Final sweep in switched excludes activeTokenId, then revoke original, then delete journal. No barrier in switched (inFlight:null). Preserve other names. Fake API holds writes SERVER-SIDE independently of dead clients until stop resolves apply/drop, can schedule mutations after sweep/final sweep/run exit, and runs a post-exit apply to expose unsafe ordering. Do not drive this fake from client lifetime. One fake API also enforces revoked-secret 401, permitted self-revoke and last-admin 409. Probe handoff follows observed-container resume table, retains new id, never rescales old+new; ready/same/2000 ms precede old stop/removal; locations serial. Admin new identity precedes console recreate/readiness/equality/own-file identity. Report inspect-derived W (or unknown if old gone). Only required consumers restart except recovery API barrier. Record signals through durable markers, POST/staging/reconcile, barrier/readback/retry/sweeps/revoke critical sections; act at boundaries with 130. Every hard-kill test retains the old lock and proves automatic stale break BEFORE recovery reads. Wire selector/journal-argument/timeout validation, HELP/COMMANDS/dispatch and stub errors. Command docs/manual equivalents and Token recovery cover staging secrets never manually deleted, reconcile order/errors, both sweeps/revoke guard, outcome rows, barrier API downtime/failure recovery with pulse up, stale lock, extra containers, lost-admin overlap expiry/manual token recovery, standalone exclusions and measured handoff cost. Document bound domains I>=200 and I>700 and separate short-interval estimate per Performance impact. Real 10-minute expiry/continuity stays in T6.

Keep this one snapshot/apply/rollback algorithm with its matrices. Fixed-host injected ghcr.io fetch: numeric stable SemVer, optional-v exact --to without leading zeros/prereleases, <=10 pages, redirect:error, 20 s, 1 MiB, checked OCI index/manifest-list digest. Sorted deduplicated snapshotVolumes includes all writable sources irrespective of suffix, omits unused/read-only volumes; complete tars keys must equal it. Require installed authenticated gh; verify each changed digest within 120 s with repo/signer-workflow/source-ref/deny-self-hosted-runners even in preview, no bypass/re-resolution; pull/write that exact digest. Preview changes 0 files/containers. Apply takes recoverable lock BEFORE guard/state reads. Immediately after guard sweep leftover helpers by existing INSTALL_LABEL+new helper label BEFORE nonterminal-directory refusal, then reject journal/incomplete/unreadable snapshot metadata. Helper sweep: list by both labels, rm -f each full id, list empty; <=3 rounds/30 s, print count when nonzero; failure names ids/recovery link with no state/restore/start. Never rely on Compose down or client kill to end standalone helpers. Label every snapshot/restore helper; use only resolved pinned secrets-init image and Decision 13 restricted network/capabilities. Sweep during abort, before first restore, after nonzero/throwing restore spawn before state write, and before EVERY upgrade/abort/rollback up. Snapshot streams each sorted volume to wx 0600 .tar.part under unique 0700 dir, fsync/size/hash/rename/directory fsync; copy/fsync/hash Compose. States snapshotting/applying/done/aborted/rolling-back/restored/rolled-back/rollback-failed with restored boolean and validated external input. Complete boundary is on-disk applying+tars, but only durable applying permits switch. State-write failures use ONE validated disk read-back and Decision 13 table, no write retry: snapshotting cleanup before stop; applying readback snapshotting aborts, applying+tars rolls back, invalid/unreadable/unexpected stops with no delete/restore/start. Abort only from disk snapshotting: sweep, unchanged Compose hash, aborted, delete archives only after durable aborted; failed aborted keeps archives but starts unchanged old stack. Rollback: durable rolling-back, stop, verify ALL tars and Compose before any data change, helper sweep, restore every volume with exact script find /to -mindepth 1 -delete && tar -C /to -xpf - && sync -f /to, restore Compose durably, durable restored, sweep/up/readiness. Each helper must exit 0 INCLUDING sync before restored; failed helper sync/extraction/spawn or Compose restore leads to sweep then rollback-failed/restored:false/no up. Failed rolling-back/restored state writes stop with no subsequent restore/start. Ready rollback -> rolled-back; failed old readiness -> rollback-failed/restored:true. Failed terminal writes preserve final stack shape with warning/exit 1; never turn failed done into rollback. Edit only image strings with count/model check and mode preserved. Record signals through state-error resolution and rollback; outputs/timeouts/0/1/130 per spec. Fake helpers keep running after client/CLI death, record delete/extract/sync phases and stop only at rm -f. Every hard-kill case keeps lock, rerun breaks it then sweeps BEFORE refusing nonterminal directory; no automatic upgrade resume. Wire HELP/COMMANDS/dispatch/errors and command docs/manual equivalents. Upgrade recovery ALWAYS starts with helper removal by BOTH labels/list empty BEFORE pulse down/restore/up; per-state facts-on-disk recovery, tar hashes, sync -f /to, restored true/false, stale lock, default-volume/path requirements, bind-to-volume migration, downtime/lost writes/disk space and Linux syncfs writeback-error kernel limit. tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, live scripts, CI, Checks and Completion evidence; Acceptance evidence 1-6, Decision 15, all Security impact/Performance impact/Risks/Rollout order. Bound functions enforce domains: doubled_runs_bound I>=200; extra_samples_bound I>700; exit 2 outside them before division. Test EVERY Counterexamples fixture including phase offsets. Docker events match full ids/service labels; timeNano yields independent T_s/T_d/W, never CLI text/2000 ms assumption. Real pinned CLI demo, both locations/admin, real 10-minute overlap/old 401s, unrelated ids/start times and secret equality/secrecy/down-up persistence, interrupted handoff no-flags resume without another rotate and E=0 after old dies. Require schema 3/self404 on A and 9/self200 on B, independent of shipped pins. Live selection fixtures assemble versions from parts.
